VAT in Germany is normally 19% of the taxable amount. However, there is a reduction to 7% for certain transactions listed in Annex 2. This reduction applies, among other things, to:

Supplies, imports and intra-Community acquisitions of certain goods (Annex 2, numbers 1 to 54). 
Letting of certain goods (Annex 2, numbers 1 to 54).
Breeding and keeping of livestock, cultivation of plants.
Services in connection with animal breeding, artificial insemination of animals and animal breeding performance tests.
Access to theaters, concerts, museums and similar cultural performances.
Letting of films for exploitation and screening.
Granting, transfer and management of copyrights.
Circus performances, showman services and turnover in the operation of zoological gardens. 
Services provided by non-profit, charitable or ecclesiastical organizations.
Transportation of persons in various means of transport.
Letting of living and sleeping accommodation and short-term letting of camping sites.
Import of certain goods.
Supplies and intra-Community acquisitions of certain goods.
Supply of certain products in electronic form.
Restaurant and catering services (after June 30, 2020 and before January 1, 2024). The tax is further reduced to 0% for certain transactions, such as the supply of solar modules for photovoltaic systems and the intra-Community acquisition of these modules. || Appendix 2: Compact forms
